description: This Java class is a builder for creating instances of MedicationDispenseCriteria by setting various properties such as Patient, Encounter, DrugOrder, and whether to include voided records.

classes.name: MedicationDispenseCriteriaBuilder
classes.description: A convenience builder class for specifying search criteria for medication dispense records in OpenMRS.

methods.name: setPatient
methods.description: Sets the Patient for the criteria.

methods.name: setEncounter
methods.description: Sets the Encounter for the criteria.

methods.name: setDrugOrder
methods.description: Sets the DrugOrder for the criteria.

methods.name: setIncludeVoided
methods.description: Specifies whether to include voided dispense records.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Constructs and returns the MedicationDispenseCriteria object with the configured properties.
